## Review boundaries

- [ ] Server permissions and ownership boundaries remain enforced.
- [ ] Examples and attached media are synthetic; no credentials or client artifacts are included.
- [ ] Documentation and requirement/test references match the resulting implementation.
- [ ] Release or cloud QA claims identify their exact source and authorization; a merge is not a deployment.
